title: SQL injection: parameterize queries
text: SQL injection in a search or lookup endpoint. Never build SQL with f-strings, concatenation, % or .format(). Use DB-API placeholders and pass values separately: cursor.execute('SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = ?', (name,)) for sqlite, %s for psycopg2 and MySQL. Verify by replaying UNION SELECT and OR 1=1 payloads and re-running static analysis.

title: Hard-coded secrets: migrate to environment
text: Hard-coded passwords, API keys and cloud access keys in source. Replace literals with os.environ[NAME], load values from a secrets manager at deploy time, and rotate every exposed secret because it already lives in git history. Add secret scanning to CI.

title: Past incident: UNION SELECT against /api/search
text: Active SQL injection (UNION SELECT) against a search endpoint exfiltrated customer rows. Contained by blocking attacker IPs at the gateway, then shipping a parameterized-query patch, then replaying the exploit. Rolling back the deploy was not needed. Rotate database credentials afterward.

title: Gateway containment: block sources and rate limit
text: While a code fix is prepared, block attacking source IPs at the API gateway and apply a rate limit to the affected path. This stops active exploitation without code changes and is reversible.

title: Past incident: Redis connection refused in workers
text: Background workers failed with connection refused to redis:6379. Fixed by resetting connections and restoring Redis. Unrelated to injection attacks.
